core_obligations: Construct the open substack: choose a commutative square presenting the morphism by a morphism of algebraic spaces, take the maximal open subspace over which that morphism is smooth, and descend the image to an open substack of the source (proof lines 7668-7685)

Identify it: by the presentation criterion the restriction of the given morphism to that substack is smooth, and any open substack over which the morphism is smooth pulls back into the chosen maximal subspace, so the substack is the largest one (proof lines 7683-7688)

Clauses (1), (2) and (3): smoothness is smooth local on the source, which gives (1), while (2) and (3) follow from the corresponding statements on the level of algebraic spaces (proof lines 7689-7694)
proof_roadmap: 取 U → X 与 V → Y 的展示方形（a 满光滑）。
概型/代数空间层面有「h 光滑的最大开子空间 U'」⇒ 其像下降为 X 的开子栈 U。
由展示刻画，f|_U 光滑；任一使 f 光滑的开子栈都拉回进 U' ⇒ U 最大。
(1) 由光滑在源上的光滑局部性；(2)(3) 由代数空间层面的对应命题。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for a morphism of algebraic stacks there is a largest open substack over which the restriction is smooth, and that its formation commutes with precomposition by smooth morphisms and with flat base change of finite presentation, and with flat base change when the morphism is locally of finite presentation (author lemma at source lines 7655-7667, label lemma-where-smooth). The proof (source lines 7668-7695) presents the morphism by algebraic spaces, takes the maximal open subspace on which the presenting morphism is smooth, descends it to an open substack through the presentation and identifies it as the largest one by the smoothness criterion; the remaining clauses are reduced to the corresponding statements for algebraic spaces (proof lines 7668-7694). The construction and maximality argument are the content. H3.
